text:
alex: quick check — I ran the docs link-checker and found 3 failing fragments: /runtime/kv-cache#how-to, /runtime/batching#fastpath, /api/quickstart#auth. They all return 404 fragment not found. tiny PR to update inbound refs + add a migrated-anchors note?
claire: can you paste the failing curl and the link-checker output? makes triage faster.
alex: sure:
```
$ curl -I https://docs.redwood.inference/runtime/kv-cache#how-to
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
...
# but our link-checker flags it because the anchor id is now "how-to-use" not "how-to"
```
sasha: yep, last week we standardized anchor ids to be more descriptive. i moved several headings; forgot to update cross-page refs.
docs-bot: Reminder: anchor migration isn't handled by the redirect system. Suggested steps: 1) update inbound links, 2) add a "Legacy anchors" section in the target page mapping old -> new, 3) run link-checker locally.
maria: i can pick up /api/quickstart#auth, that's likely a heading rename after the auth guide reorg.
claire: i'll do batching anchor — small PR. alex, can you open the PR and list each changed incoming file? that makes reviews faster.
alex: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4335 — fixes 5 files, adds legacy anchors note to two pages. ci-bot: CI started for PR#4335 — link-checker in progress.
ci-bot: Link-checker results: all fragments fixed except /runtime/batching#fastpath (still missing).
sasha: i overlooked that header; i'll push a tiny commit in 10m.
claire: once that's in i'll review. also, can we add a one-line checklist to the docs PR template to run `yarn link-check` and verify fragments? i can PR the template after these fixes.
docs-bot: Suggested checklist entry: "Run link-checker and verify fragment anchors (y/n)". Also consider adding `gh-actions` step to warn on fragment mismatches.
alex: thanks all — aiming to merge after ci is green and claire approves. tagging for visibility. :shipit:
